'''Barret''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Chief of Security/Legends|security chief]] of [[Outpost Thorazan]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] for the [[Citizens' Militia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR:PeS" />
